```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

# Match the normal/filtered output directories used by the regression,
# Boruta, and LASSO notebooks. Input filenames are unchanged.
results_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_RESULTS_DIR", unset = "Results")
feature_variant <- tolower(Sys.getenv("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT", unset = "normal"))
if (!(feature_variant %in% c("normal", "filtered"))) {
  stop("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT must be 'normal' or 'filtered'.")
}

table_dir <- file.path(results_dir, if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "Table_Results_filtered"
} else {
  "Table_Results"
})
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "Figure_Results_filtered"
} else {
  "Figure_Results"
})

# The leaf-order reference is a separate prerequisite not generated by
# the current feature_distribution.Rmd. Default to the shared normal folder;
# FHS_CLUSTER_DIR may point to a different label set if available.
cluster_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_CLUSTER_DIR", unset = file.path(results_dir, "Table_Results"))
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load model results

```{r}
# Input tables are produced by speech_markers_amyloid, Boruta, and LASSO.
lm_tau<-read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "lm_featureDemoAmyloidTauLmd_select.csv"))
boruta_tau<-read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "boruta_tauAmyloidFeatureLMdDemo.csv"))
boruta_amyloid<-read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "boruta_amyloidFeatureLMdDemo.csv"))
```


```{r}
lasso_lm<-read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "lasso_lm_tau.csv"))
```

```{r}
lasso_lm<-lasso_lm[,c(2,3,5:8)]
```

```{r}
# Reuse the original dendrogram leaf order for feature labels in all panels.
# Cluster assignments are not required for this plotting script.
cluster_label<-read.csv(file.path(cluster_dir, "Linguistic_feature_dendrogram_leaf_label.csv"))
```


## Linear regression coefficients
```{r}
# Reshape significant feature–region coefficients for plotting.
lm_tau<-lm_tau[,c('Outcome','Feature',"Estimate","Pr")]
names(lm_tau)<-c('Feature','Region',"lm_fdt_Estimate","lm_fdt_Pr")
```

```{r}
lm_tau_wider <- lm_tau[,1:3] %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Region,  
    values_from =lm_fdt_Estimate,  
    values_fill = NA  
  )
```

```{r}
lm_tau_long<-lm_tau_wider%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(2,4:7), 
    names_to = 'Region', values_to = "Value"
  )%>%
  mutate(Sign = ifelse(Value >= 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
         AbsValue = abs(as.double(Value)))

lm_leaf<-cluster_label[cluster_label$Label%in%lm_tau$Feature,]

lm_tau_long <- lm_tau_long %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature,levels =lm_leaf ),
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c('Amygdala','Entorhinal',"Inferiorparietal","Inferiortemporal",'Precuneus'))       
  )
```


```{r}
lm_plot<-ggplot(lm_tau_long, aes(x = Feature, y = Region)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Sign, fill = AbsValue), color = "black", size = 4, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c('white','black'),
                       values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.3)),
                       limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Positive" = 21, "Negative" = 24)) +  # 21: Circle with fill, 24: Triangle with fill
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20))) +
  labs( x=NULL,y=NULL,fill = "Absolute \n Coefficient", shape = "Sign", title = "LM Model") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))+
   theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),   
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20)    
  )


lm_plot <- lm_plot + 
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                title.hjust = 0.5))

```


## LASSO coefficients

```{r}
# Preserve the original coefficient encoding from logistic_lasso.Rmd.
lasso_lm_long<-lasso_lm%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 2:6, names_to = 'Region',values_to ='Coefficient')%>%
  mutate(Sign = ifelse(Coefficient >= 0, "Positive", ifelse(Coefficient ==-1,'Be removed',"Negative")),
         AbsValue = abs(Coefficient))
```

```{r}
lasso_lm_long<-lasso_lm_long[lasso_lm_long$Coefficient!=0,]
lasso_lm_leaf<-cluster_label[cluster_label$Label%in%lasso_lm$Feature,]
```


```{r}
lasso_lm_long<-lasso_lm_long%>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature,levels = lasso_lm_leaf),
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c('Amygdala','Entorhinal',"Inferiorparietal","Inferiortemporal",'Precuneus'))
  )
```


```{r}
lasso_lm_plot<-ggplot(lasso_lm_long, aes(x = Feature, y = Region)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Sign, fill = AbsValue), color = "black", size = 4, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c('white','black'),
                       limits = c(0, 0.2)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Positive" = 21, "Negative" = 24, 'Be removed' = 4)) +  # 21: Circle with fill, 24: Triangle with fill
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,  fill = "Absolute \n Coefficient", shape = "Sign", title = "Lasso Model for LM Results") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))+
   theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),   
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20)    
  )

lasso_lm_plot <- lasso_lm_plot + 
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                title.hjust = 0.5)) 
```



## Boruta feature-stability counts
```{r}
# Retain the same original row and regional-column subset (excluding Putamen).
# These fixed indices assume the original feature ordering in the Boruta tables.
boruta_tau<-boruta_tau[2:55,c(1:2,4:7)]
```

```{r}
boruta_amyloid<-boruta_amyloid[2:55,c(1,2)]
names(boruta_amyloid)<-c("Feature",'Amyloid')
```

```{r}
boruta_data<-merge(boruta_tau,boruta_amyloid,by = 'Feature')
```

```{r}
boruta_data_long<-pivot_longer(boruta_data,
                         cols=c(2:7),
                         names_to='region',
                         values_to='count')
boruta_data_long<-boruta_data_long[boruta_data_long$count!=0,]
names(boruta_data_long)<-c('Feature','Region','boruta_count')
```

```{r}
boruta_leaf<-cluster_label[cluster_label$Label%in%boruta_data$Feature,]

boruta_data_long <- boruta_data_long %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature,levels =boruta_leaf ),
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c('Amyloid', 'Amygdala', 'Entorhinal',"Inferiorparietal","Inferiortemporal",'Precuneus'))       
  )
```



```{r}
boruta_plot <- ggplot(boruta_data_long, aes(x = Feature, y = Region)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = boruta_count),   
    shape  = 21,                
    size   = 4,
    color  = "black",          
    stroke = 0.8                
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", "black"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.3)),
    limits = c(0, 20)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Count Number\n(20 permutations)",
    title = "Boruta Model"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  )+
   theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),   
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20)    
  )


```


```{r}
# Add margins to prevent axis labels from being clipped
plot_margin <- theme(
  # X-axis feature names
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0.5
  ),

  # Y-axis region names
  axis.text.y = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ),

  # Axis titles
  axis.title = element_text(
    size = 15,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ),

  # Panel titles
  plot.title = element_text(
    size = 18,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0.5
  ),

  # Legend title
  legend.title = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ),

  # Legend labels
  legend.text = element_text(
    size = 12,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ),

  # Additional margins to avoid clipping
  plot.margin = margin(
    t = 20,
    r = 20,
    b = 65,
    l = 30,
    unit = "pt"
  )
)
plot_margin <- plot_margin + theme(
  axis.line = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ),
  axis.ticks = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.7),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3)
)
# Apply consistent formatting
lm_plot <- lm_plot + plot_margin
lasso_lm_plot <- lasso_lm_plot + plot_margin
boruta_plot <- boruta_plot + plot_margin
```


## Combine and export panels

```{r}
# Arrange linear regression and LASSO on the first row, Boruta below.
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)


layout <- rbind(
  c(1, 2),
  c(3, 3)
)

combined_grob <- arrangeGrob(
  lm_plot,
  lasso_lm_plot,
  boruta_plot,
  layout_matrix = layout,
  heights = c(1, 1.1),
  padding = unit(0.5, "line")
)

# Preserve the original PNG filename and high-resolution export settings.
png(file.path(figure_dir, "combined_plot_updated.png"), width = 16, height = 14, units = "in", res = 1200)
grid.draw(combined_grob)
dev.off()



```

```{r}
# Export the same composition as an LZW-compressed TIFF.
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "combined_plot_updated.tif"), dpi = 300,combined_grob, width = 16, height = 18,compression = "lzw")
```
